messages.english: Follow saved grower cycles on their exact planned dates.
messages.text: Landela imijikelezo yokutshala egciniwe ngezinsuku zayo ezihleliwe eziqondile.

messages.english: Check current designs before ticking work or exporting dates.
messages.text: Hlola imiklamo yamanje ngaphambi kokumaka umsebenzi noma ukukhipha izinsuku.

messages.english: Keep own crop estimates separate from catalogue print advice.
messages.text: Gcina izilinganiso zakho zezitshalo zihlukene nezeluleko zekhathalogi eziphrintiwe.

messages.english: Task Planner → Dated work from your estimates
messages.text: Umhleli Wemisebenzi → Umsebenzi onezinsuku ovela ezilinganisweni zakho

messages.english: Open Task Planner to check work dates from your saved growing estimates.
messages.text: Vula Umhleli Wemisebenzi ukuze uhlole izinsuku zomsebenzi ezisuselwa ezilinganisweni zakho zokutshala ezigciniwe.
